title: Zesty American Sardine Wrap
description: A flexitarian-friendly dish featuring sardines in a jammy and gooey wrap, cooked to perfection with leaf wrap steam, perfect for a cozy American meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the flaked sardines, chopped onion, chopped bell pepper, salsa, and chopped cilantro.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper, and pour the mixture over the sardine mixture, stirring to combine.
Lay a large tortilla flat on a work surface and spoon about 1/4 of the sardine mixture onto the center of the tortilla.
Sprinkle about 1/4 cup of shredded cheese over the sardine mixture.
Fold the bottom edge of the tortilla up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
Repeat the process with the remaining tortillas and filling.
Wrap each tortilla in a large leaf, such as a collard green or mustard green, and place the wraps in a steamer basket.
Steam the wraps over boiling water for 5 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the tortillas are soft and pliable.
Serve the wraps hot, garnished with additional chopped cilantro if desired.
